description: This file defines a React functional component 'VideoPlayer' that provides a custom video player interface using expo-av's Video component. It handles video playback, controls (play/pause, rewind, forward, fullscreen), loading states, error handling, and fallback UIs for invalid sources or errors.

methods.name: VideoPlayer
methods.description: A React functional component that renders a video player with custom controls, handling play, pause, seek, fullscreen, loading, and error states.
